# JFeelgood

> Original paintings, mixed media, books, and limited-edition collectible art cards by JFeelgood — an Austin, Texas-based artist with over 18 years of creative work across hundreds of paintings, five published books, five music albums, and a video game.

JFeelgood creates one-of-a-kind original artworks that explore identity, resilience, solitude, ego, and the human experience. Work spans acrylic, mixed media, gold leaf, epoxy resin, spray paint, and found materials on canvas and wood.

## Site Pages

- [Home](https://jfeelgood.com/): An explorable first-person 3D planet (desktop, WebGL). Walk a golden world where featured paintings stand as giant billboards, the 186-work archive hangs inside a gallery rotunda, and the Self Work series, books, and art cards each have their own place on the terrain. A garage on the terrain houses four drivable/flyable vehicles — a UAV drone, a plane, a tank, and a motorcycle — for exploring the hills, mountains, forests, deserts, and lakes.
- [Classic Site](https://jfeelgood.com/classic.html): The same content as a traditional page — featured paintings, the Self Work series, the story of the artist's growth, books, and limited-edition art cards. Served automatically to mobile and non-WebGL visitors.
- [Archives Wall](https://jfeelgood.com/archives.html): 186 paintings spanning 2004–2025 in a single scrolling wall.

- [Dreamfall](https://minicuration.com/shop/dreamfall.html): $23. Edition of 50.

## Original Paintings

Originals are one-of-one and never reproduced as originals. Selected available works (inquiries via [Instagram @artistjfeelgood](https://www.instagram.com/artistjfeelgood)):

- Poetry of Solace: $900. 16×20 in. Acrylic on canvas. A solitary figure on a glowing pathway beneath a star-studded sky. From the series "The Lost." Featured in *Thought Entropy*.
- Adonis: $400. 16×20 in. Acrylic on canvas. A stylized face in soft muted tones against vibrant yellow. Single blue tear.
- Veritas: $1,200. 24×30 in. Mixed media on canvas. A transparent princess figure on stage against an abstract explosion of color.
- Path of Privilege: $2,000. 12×12 in, depth 4 in. Mixed media on wood — gold leaf, epoxy resin, affixed paintbrushes. Commentary on race, systemic inequality, and privilege.
- The Mother Essence: $5,000. 36×36 in. Acrylic, latex, spray paint, acetone, found paper on hand-stretched canvas. Created 2011. From the private *Past & Future* series.

## Series

- Past & Future: Private fine art series. Large-scale mixed media works including The Mother Essence, Ancestors, Sisters, The Father Piece, and The Two Brothers.
- Ascension: 2021 fine art series. Four acrylic-on-canvas works using intentional constraints — two colors per piece, bold minimal composition. First shown at Austin Studio Tour 2021 at Central Machine Works.
- Self Work: 2021 fine art series. Eight of ten mixed media works exploring ego, identity, and sobriety. Acrylic on canvas with epoxy resin finish. Pieces nine and ten remain unfinished because self work is never done. Shown on the [home page](https://jfeelgood.com/#selfwork).
- Marbled Falls: A series of smaller original works (sold). Includes Doggo, Kitten, Golden Sands, Catching Feels, Dino, Unlocked, VHS.

## Books

- [Thought Entropy](https://a.co/d/0fFdIXFf): 20 years of paintings, poems, and visual stories. Available on Amazon.
- [The Book of Shadow Work](https://a.co/d/00Z3mt2Q): Part story, part mirror, part workbook for inner excavation. Available on Amazon. Companion site: [thebookofshadowwork.com](https://thebookofshadowwork.com).

## About the Artist

JFeelgood has over 18 years of experience across painting, mixed media, sculpture, writing, music, and game design. He has produced several hundred original paintings, five published books, five music albums, and a video game ([NOVA 7](https://nova7game.org)). He has organized community art events and served in leadership roles at art organizations.

In 2019 JFeelgood chose sobriety — from alcohol, cigarettes, self-medication, and the life he had been living — and channeled that transformation into the Self Work series. His practice is rooted in accountability, introspection, and the belief that powerful messages need very little to convey their strength.

## Press

"Jonny's wisdom and insight belie his youthful appearance; his still waters run seriously deep." — The Confounded Cook, 2011, Gallery Off Broadway. Interview by Crystal Pratt.
